title: Taking up trombone after the First World War
summary: The band ran out of trombone players so he took it up; the band owned the instruments; he moved to New Orleans in 1921.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. When did you take up trombone? I'd taken up trombone and, uh, just after the First World War.
That's around about 1918. Mm-hmm. Were you still living up there in Tebido then? No, I was living in Tebido. I was living in Tebido. I didn't come down here until 1921.
